report.verdict: A senior backend engineer with substantial payments work and results a recruiter can follow.
write_up: This is a strong senior backend resume! At Lumen Ledger, you show payments infrastructure work at scale, then explain how you migrated the ledger and made the balance API faster. A recruiter can see both the systems you built and what changed.

The balance API line is a model: it gives the starting and ending latency and names the technical change. Your progression from insurance to freight to payments is easy to follow. The oldest role is thinner, but it doesn't obscure your recent work.

Let's give the claims intake line a little more substance, then consider adding a broader technical decision from the ledger migration for roles above senior. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing standing between you and a callback; the competition for a particular role and a referral can still matter.

cards.line: Maintained the claims intake services in Java
cards.cannot_tell: Maintained could cover several kinds of work. A recruiter can't tell what you changed in the claims services.
cards.example: Maintained the claims intake services in Java by [work performed]
cards.question: What work did you do on the claims intake services?

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 3
cards.line: Cut p99 latency on the balance API from 900 ms to 140 ms by moving reads to a Kafka-fed cache
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It puts a measurable improvement next to the engineering choice that produced it.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 2
cards.line: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends
cards.cannot_tell: For a role above senior, a broader technical decision behind this migration would show how you shaped the system.
cards.example: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends, including [a broader technical decision you made]
cards.question: What broader technical decision did you make for the ledger migration, if any?

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 4
cards.line: Wrote the on-call runbooks for the payments services and ran the incident reviews for the platform group
cards.cannot_tell: A change adopted after an incident review would show what the platform group took forward from that work.
cards.example: Wrote the on-call runbooks for the payments services and ran the incident reviews for the platform group, leading to [change adopted]
cards.question: What change, if any, followed the incident reviews?

fit.why: Your headline and recent work both point to senior backend engineering, particularly payments services and data infrastructure.
fit.level: senior, leads a ledger migration and mentors two mid-level engineers
fit.note: Your experience points toward backend roles working on payments and distributed systems. The payouts service, ledger migration and balance API give you distinct work to lead with.
